reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

et.et_units: ET is ABSOLUTE minutes since midnight on the canonical grid, so 540 = 09:00, 600 = 10:00, 780 = 13:00 and 900 = 15:00. The *_before_* / *_after_* shares below are literal clock-time thresholds on that same scale

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold
exit_reason_meanings.terminal: the session reached its boundary with the claim still held

exposure.definition: engine snapshot = sum over claims of shares x the engine's last-finite causal mark, as an ACCOUNT FRACTION. That mark reads 0 for a claim that never had one, so a snapshot can UNDERSTATE a held position; the understating counts are published below rather than corrected
exposure.early_vs_afternoon_reading: 585 is the early-window mark and 690/780 the afternoon marks. A book that traded but is flat at 585 was flat BEFORE the afternoon, so the absence of afternoon exposure is not evidence that a morning trade failed

definitions.buy_gross_deployed: sum of fills.gross_fraction over buys, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_two_legs: that plus the same sum over sells, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_per_deployed_dollar: gross_traded_two_legs / buy_gross_deployed: the two-legged turnover multiple per deployed account dollar. It is a ratio of sums inside THIS cell and never a portfolio figure

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: this cell executed NO re-entry, so no sale proceeds were ever redeployed: every buy came from the claim's own initial segregated 1/n slot and the intraday cash-re-use delay could not bind. The minute-lag caveat is therefore not a blocker for this book
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

dates.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

trades.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

definitions.gross_traded_per_deployed_dollar: gross_traded_two_legs / buy_gross_deployed: the two-legged turnover multiple per deployed account dollar. It is a ratio of sums inside THIS cell and never a portfolio figure

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: every executed fresh buy beyond a claim's FIRST is funded from that claim's own previously SOLD, SETTLED net receipt; the receipt only becomes spendable at exec_et + 1 minute
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

dates.share_note: share of this cell's total net carried by its k largest book-days or closed pairs, on the KNOWN set only: a concentration measure, not a rule

trades.share_note: share of this cell's total net carried by its k largest book-days or closed pairs, on the KNOWN set only: a concentration measure, not a rule

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

et.et_units: ET is ABSOLUTE minutes since midnight on the canonical grid, so 540 = 09:00, 600 = 10:00, 780 = 13:00 and 900 = 15:00. The *_before_* / *_after_* shares below are literal clock-time thresholds on that same scale

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold
exit_reason_meanings.terminal: the session reached its boundary with the claim still held

exposure.definition: engine snapshot = sum over claims of shares x the engine's last-finite causal mark, as an ACCOUNT FRACTION. That mark reads 0 for a claim that never had one, so a snapshot can UNDERSTATE a held position; the understating counts are published below rather than corrected
exposure.early_vs_afternoon_reading: 585 is the early-window mark and 690/780 the afternoon marks. A book that traded but is flat at 585 was flat BEFORE the afternoon, so the absence of afternoon exposure is not evidence that a morning trade failed

definitions.gross_traded_per_deployed_dollar: gross_traded_two_legs / buy_gross_deployed: the two-legged turnover multiple per deployed account dollar. It is a ratio of sums inside THIS cell and never a portfolio figure

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: this cell executed NO re-entry, so no sale proceeds were ever redeployed: every buy came from the claim's own initial segregated 1/n slot and the intraday cash-re-use delay could not bind. The minute-lag caveat is therefore not a blocker for this book
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

dates.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

trades.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

et.et_units: ET is ABSOLUTE minutes since midnight on the canonical grid, so 540 = 09:00, 600 = 10:00, 780 = 13:00 and 900 = 15:00. The *_before_* / *_after_* shares below are literal clock-time thresholds on that same scale

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold
exit_reason_meanings.terminal: the session reached its boundary with the claim still held

exposure.definition: engine snapshot = sum over claims of shares x the engine's last-finite causal mark, as an ACCOUNT FRACTION. That mark reads 0 for a claim that never had one, so a snapshot can UNDERSTATE a held position; the understating counts are published below rather than corrected
exposure.early_vs_afternoon_reading: 585 is the early-window mark and 690/780 the afternoon marks. A book that traded but is flat at 585 was flat BEFORE the afternoon, so the absence of afternoon exposure is not evidence that a morning trade failed

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold

definitions.buy_gross_deployed: sum of fills.gross_fraction over buys, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_two_legs: that plus the same sum over sells, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price

participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

et.et_units: ET is ABSOLUTE minutes since midnight on the canonical grid, so 540 = 09:00, 600 = 10:00, 780 = 13:00 and 900 = 15:00. The *_before_* / *_after_* shares below are literal clock-time thresholds on that same scale

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold
exit_reason_meanings.terminal: the session reached its boundary with the claim still held

exposure.definition: engine snapshot = sum over claims of shares x the engine's last-finite causal mark, as an ACCOUNT FRACTION. That mark reads 0 for a claim that never had one, so a snapshot can UNDERSTATE a held position; the understating counts are published below rather than corrected
exposure.early_vs_afternoon_reading: 585 is the early-window mark and 690/780 the afternoon marks. A book that traded but is flat at 585 was flat BEFORE the afternoon, so the absence of afternoon exposure is not evidence that a morning trade failed

definitions.buy_gross_deployed: sum of fills.gross_fraction over buys, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_two_legs: that plus the same sum over sells, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_per_deployed_dollar: gross_traded_two_legs / buy_gross_deployed: the two-legged turnover multiple per deployed account dollar. It is a ratio of sums inside THIS cell and never a portfolio figure

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: this cell executed NO re-entry, so no sale proceeds were ever redeployed: every buy came from the claim's own initial segregated 1/n slot and the intraday cash-re-use delay could not bind. The minute-lag caveat is therefore not a blocker for this book

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

et.et_units: ET is ABSOLUTE minutes since midnight on the canonical grid, so 540 = 09:00, 600 = 10:00, 780 = 13:00 and 900 = 15:00. The *_before_* / *_after_* shares below are literal clock-time thresholds on that same scale

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold
exit_reason_meanings.terminal: the session reached its boundary with the claim still held

exposure.definition: engine snapshot = sum over claims of shares x the engine's last-finite causal mark, as an ACCOUNT FRACTION. That mark reads 0 for a claim that never had one, so a snapshot can UNDERSTATE a held position; the understating counts are published below rather than corrected
exposure.early_vs_afternoon_reading: 585 is the early-window mark and 690/780 the afternoon marks. A book that traded but is flat at 585 was flat BEFORE the afternoon, so the absence of afternoon exposure is not evidence that a morning trade failed

definitions.buy_gross_deployed: sum of fills.gross_fraction over buys, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_two_legs: that plus the same sum over sells, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_per_deployed_dollar: gross_traded_two_legs / buy_gross_deployed: the two-legged turnover multiple per deployed account dollar. It is a ratio of sums inside THIS cell and never a portfolio figure

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: every executed fresh buy beyond a claim's FIRST is funded from that claim's own previously SOLD, SETTLED net receipt; the receipt only becomes spendable at exec_et + 1 minute
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

dates.share_note: share of this cell's total net carried by its k largest book-days or closed pairs, on the KNOWN set only: a concentration measure, not a rule

trades.share_note: share of this cell's total net carried by its k largest book-days or closed pairs, on the KNOWN set only: a concentration measure, not a rule

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: this cell executed NO re-entry, so no sale proceeds were ever redeployed: every buy came from the claim's own initial segregated 1/n slot and the intraday cash-re-use delay could not bind. The minute-lag caveat is therefore not a blocker for this book
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

dates.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

trades.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold

definitions.buy_gross_deployed: sum of fills.gross_fraction over buys, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out
reason_meanings.unresolved_fresh_buy: a fresh buy with a finite price and a finite exec_et that falls outside the session: a real funding attempt whose outcome never resolved. The tickers are named by the producer BEFORE the pending orders are discarded
reason_meanings.affordability_gap: the fixed quantity cost more than the claim's own settled slot or than cash on hand. The order is never resized and never levered; it stays UNKNOWN
reason_meanings.unattributed_attempted_lower_bound: attempted orders whose causal mark was unusable, or whose next open was missing or non-finite. The engine names those tickers only inside its own union, so this reader reports the REMAINDER as a COUNTED LOWER BOUND and never splits it by guesswork

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

et.et_units: ET is ABSOLUTE minutes since midnight on the canonical grid, so 540 = 09:00, 600 = 10:00, 780 = 13:00 and 900 = 15:00. The *_before_* / *_after_* shares below are literal clock-time thresholds on that same scale

exit_reason_meanings.state_release: the frozen forecast turned negative, so the HELD claim was sold
exit_reason_meanings.terminal: the session reached its boundary with the claim still held

exposure.definition: engine snapshot = sum over claims of shares x the engine's last-finite causal mark, as an ACCOUNT FRACTION. That mark reads 0 for a claim that never had one, so a snapshot can UNDERSTATE a held position; the understating counts are published below rather than corrected
exposure.early_vs_afternoon_reading: 585 is the early-window mark and 690/780 the afternoon marks. A book that traded but is flat at 585 was flat BEFORE the afternoon, so the absence of afternoon exposure is not evidence that a morning trade failed

definitions.buy_gross_deployed: sum of fills.gross_fraction over buys, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_two_legs: that plus the same sum over sells, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_per_deployed_dollar: gross_traded_two_legs / buy_gross_deployed: the two-legged turnover multiple per deployed account dollar. It is a ratio of sums inside THIS cell and never a portfolio figure

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: this cell executed NO re-entry, so no sale proceeds were ever redeployed: every buy came from the claim's own initial segregated 1/n slot and the intraday cash-re-use delay could not bind. The minute-lag caveat is therefore not a blocker for this book
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: every executed fresh buy beyond a claim's FIRST is funded from that claim's own previously SOLD, SETTLED net receipt; the receipt only becomes spendable at exec_et + 1 minute
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

dates.share_note: share of this cell's total net carried by its k largest book-days or closed pairs, on the KNOWN set only: a concentration measure, not a rule

trades.share_note: share of this cell's total net carried by its k largest book-days or closed pairs, on the KNOWN set only: a concentration measure, not a rule

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims

meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: this cell executed NO re-entry, so no sale proceeds were ever redeployed: every buy came from the claim's own initial segregated 1/n slot and the intraday cash-re-use delay could not bind. The minute-lag caveat is therefore not a blocker for this book
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. This is a CONCENTRATION DIAGNOSTIC only: no cut, cap, exclusion, entry rule or exit rule is derived from it, none is proposed here, and nothing was optimized on it

dates.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

trades.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact

definitions.buy_gross_deployed: sum of fills.gross_fraction over buys, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_two_legs: that plus the same sum over sells, ACCOUNT FRACTIONS
definitions.gross_traded_per_deployed_dollar: gross_traded_two_legs / buy_gross_deployed: the two-legged turnover multiple per deployed account dollar. It is a ratio of sums inside THIS cell and never a portfolio figure

participation.definition: participation = fills.shares_per_capital * 10000.0 / panel.sell_volume, where shares_per_capital is SHARES PER ONE ACCOUNT DOLLAR (the ledger starts at cash = 1.0), 10000.0 USD is the engine's PUBLISHED notional argument default which the producer never overrides, and sell_volume is the traded share volume of the canonical bar row whose OPEN is the fill price
participation.unit: fraction of that minute's traded volume (0.01 = 1% of the bar's volume)
participation.certification: SIZE-OVER-VOLUME PROXY ONLY. Not a quote-level or queue-position participation rate; no venue, no route, no probability of fill, and nothing about a broker

round_trip_pairs.definition: an entry/exit pair at the FIXED quantity the engine used: a sell closes the whole position and a buy is never resized after its decision mark, so pair quantities are identical by construction and VERIFIED here per pair. net_account = sell gross - sell fee - buy gross - buy fee, in ACCOUNT FRACTIONS

entry.meaning: the FIRST executed fresh buy of a (book, ticker): a fresh entry cost

reentry.meaning: every later executed fresh buy of the same claim, allowed only under the repeat cycle control; reported separately, never pooled with entry

sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.why: this cell executed NO re-entry, so no sale proceeds were ever redeployed: every buy came from the claim's own initial segregated 1/n slot and the intraday cash-re-use delay could not bind. The minute-lag caveat is therefore not a blocker for this book
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation: a claim's slot is funded only from ITS OWN cash; no slot is ever funded from another claim's proceeds and nothing is resized onto one
sale_proceeds_reuse_is_reachable_here.segregation_is_auditable_not_certified: the no-borrow rule is verified from the published cash_slot_end / settled_receipt columns, but it is an in-model ledger rule; no broker account, order-routing remainder or partial-fill quantity is certified, and pre-market order qty remaining is likewise not certified

outlier_dependence.purpose: measure how much of an ALREADY PUBLISHED mean rests on a handful of book-days or a handful of closed pairs. dates.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

trades.share_note: total is not positive, so share-of-total concentration is undefined; it is reported as null rather than as a signed or absolute substitute

outlier_dependence.date_trade_note: the two blocks are NOT expected to tie: a book-day nets every claim it touched, including positions still open at the close, while the trade block counts only CLOSED pairs. The difference is the open-position UNKNOWN mass, reported in the reconciliation block

mark_to_next_open_gap.measures: the ACTUAL next-open fill price against the CAUSAL mark the order was sized on, both from the source panel row of the order itself: mark = close of the last COMPLETED bar with et <= decision_et-1, fill = open of the first valid bar with et >= decision_et
mark_to_next_open_gap.sign: positive = the actual open was HIGHER than the causal mark
mark_to_next_open_gap.mark_not_exact_meaning: the mark on the order's own panel row was not finite, so the engine would have carried an EARLIER mark this reader cannot see. Those legs are excluded from the gap rather than filled with a guess
mark_to_next_open_gap.sell_gap_is_descriptive_only: a sell quantity is fixed by the shares held and is never sized off a mark, so the sell gap is exit context, not a sizing error

cells.comparison_guard: compare only against a cell with the identical day set, clock, n and side_cost; `cycles` is the predeclared control and is named, never collapsed. These cells are ALTERNATIVE books, not sleeves of one portfolio, and their money is never summed

money_known_set.book_set: KNOWN books only (ret not null); UNKNOWN books are excluded entirely

producer_summary_crosscheck.book_set_note: the producer's summary.ev, summary.fees and summary.gross_pnl are means over the SAME known book set, while summary.orders and the mean_* columns are means over ALL books; quoting an all-book order mean beside a known-set fee would attribute money to a different day set

reconciliation.gross_fills_definition: buys negative, sells positive, matching the engine's flow

net_comparisons.book_set: KNOWN books only, and only those with every member known and no position left open, so member net and closed-pair net are each compared against that book's OWN ret
net_comparisons.known_support_rule: every KNOWN book must carry its complete unique roster with no UNKNOWN member and no open pair; known_books_not_comparable is a verification failure, not an exclusion that can hide contradictory support

reconciliation.closed_pair_qty_rule: a closed pair's buy and sell quantities must be equal; a mismatch means the engine resized or partially filled, which this reader does not model

meanings.claim_entry_share: claims that executed at least one fresh buy / roster claims
meanings.member_unknown_share: members with net_pnl null / all members; UNKNOWN, never 0
meanings.idle_share_of_assigned_slots: sum of per-claim cash still idle at the close / sum of the 1/n slots assigned at t=0; the unassigned remainder is reported separately and is never borrowed across claims

disjoint_member_classification.note: this is a disjoint partition of the member frame: a member is UNKNOWN either because its position was still held at the terminal boundary or because an attempted order never produced a leg. It partitions members, not books

reason_meanings.open_at_close: held when the terminal boundary arrived, so no exit open existed inside the session; UNKNOWN, not marked out

uncertainty.unknown_is_never_imputed: UNKNOWN books and claims contribute no mean, no median, no fee average and no EV anywhere in this artifact
